titolo: Alaska Is Hiding Something Most Americans Never Notice

scene.testo: Alaska is so big, it breaks the map.
It is more than twice the size of Texas.
Yet most Americans never see its strangest side.
Alaska has more than three million lakes.
Its coastline is longer than all other states combined.
Glaciers here are slowly carving the land itself.
Some towns can't be reached by any road.
Mail, food and fuel often arrive by air.
The state capital, Juneau, cannot be reached by road either.
You can only arrive there by boat or plane.
In summer, the sun barely sets in places.
In winter, the sky lights up green.
Denali rises above everything, the tallest peak in North America.
Brown bears fish for salmon in its rivers.
Huge parts of the state are wilderness without a single road.
But that's not the strangest part.
Beneath the ice and frozen ground, something is changing.
Stay with me, because it affects the whole country.
